intro: Oil and gas make up most of Algeria's exports and government income.

chapters.title: Oil and gas
text: Algeria is a major gas supplier to Europe through pipelines to Italy and Spain.
The state company Sonatrach is Africa's biggest company.

chapters.title: Beyond oil
text: Dates from Saharan oases, especially Deglet Nour, are a famous export.

keyTerms.meaning: A long pipe carrying oil or gas.

cardGroups.title: Made in Algeria
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Algeria makes and sells to the world.
